from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingResult(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial metric entry extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year covered by the report")
    line_item: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item name, e.g., 'Loss from Operations'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported for the line item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the report, e.g. 'USD'")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the currency, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_results: list[OperatingResult]
